text:
leila (Product): Quick announcement: Starting next week we'll open a small Dedicated A100X pool in eu-north-1 as a controlled preview. Target go-live: 2026-04-10 09:00 UTC. This is reserved for Dedicated customers and selected pilots. Please read notes below.
ignacio (Eng-Platform): Details: initial capacity ~30 GPUs (5 nodes). Reservation required for guaranteed access. Console will show `dedicated.a100x.preview.eu-north-1`.
nina (Eng-SRE): SRE checklist done. No infra downtime expected. Pools tagged: a100x-eu-preview, dedicated-eun1. Deploy will be automated via infra pipeline.
infra-bot: Change scheduled: ADD_POOL eu-north-1 a100x count=5 change_id=CHG-20260410-4412 eta=2026-04-10T09:00:00Z
ignacio (Eng-Platform): API example for reservation:
```
POST /v1/reservations
{
  "region": "eu-north-1",
  "gpu_type": "a100x",
  "count": 2,
  "term": "monthly"
}
```
Note: preview reservations will be marked `preview=true` on the object.
leila (Product): Pricing: preview rate is +10% over existing A100 baseline. Billing ledger label: `dedicated.a100x.preview`. No SLA during preview.
ops-jordan: Reservation policy updates for preview:
- Minimum term: 1 month
- Early cancel: 5 days notice
- Priority: enterprise customers with Dedicated contracts get first allocation
If you need an exception DM me.
ignacio (Eng-Platform): Routing behavior: requests specifying `gpu_type=a100x` route to the preview pool. If capacity exhausted, clients will get `INSUFFICIENT_CAPACITY` unless `allow_queue=true`. Recommend fallback `gpu_type=a100` in client configs for critical paths.
leila (Product): Action items: 1) Teams who want preview access, submit reservation before 2026-04-08 23:59 UTC. 2) Try workloads with your staging traffic and report issues to #eng-platform.
nina (Eng-SRE): Monitoring: dashboards created under Console -> Dedicated -> Pools -> eu-north-1 -> a100x. We'll watch OOMs, GPU temp, and scheduling latency for 72h after launch.
leila (Product): Thanks team — we'll post a short exec note after 48h with early metrics. :sparkles:
